fields.name: id
fields.label: ID
fields.description: Optional ID. Use #my-id to link directly to this accordion. When opened via the URL, the accordion opens automatically and scrolls into view.

fields.name: close_neighbouring_accordions
fields.label: Close adjacent accordions
fields.description: Automatically closes adjacent open accordions when this one is opened.

fields.name: scroll_to_accordion_top
fields.label: Scroll to accordion on open
fields.description: Automatically scrolls to the start of the accordion when opened. Especially useful on mobile with long content.

children.name: add_to_faq_schema
children.label: Add to FAQ schema
children.description: Uses this accordion’s content as question and answer for structured FAQ data. Only use for real FAQs.

settings.description: Expandable section with a heading and free-form content.

fields.name: id
fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.description: Unique ID for this anchor. Use lowercase letters and hyphens only. Use #my-id to link directly to this position or scroll there automatically when the page loads.

fields.name: offset
fields.label: Offset
fields.description: Optional offset in pixels when auto-scrolling.

settings.description: Invisible jump target for internal links (#anchor-id) with optional scroll offset.

fields.name: post_taxonomy
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Filters the list by a category.

fields.name: has_category_filters
fields.label: Show category filter
fields.description: Shows category filters above the list.

settings.description: Lists posts of a content type with optional filtering and pagination.
Google Maps by address or coordinates. A consent notice appears before loading; the map is embedded only after approval.
Lets visitors grant or revoke Google Maps consent independently of the map — e.g. on the privacy page.

children.name: label
children.label: Caption
children.description: Text below the number.

children.name: prefix
children.label: Prefix
children.description: Text before the number.

children.name: suffix
children.label: Suffix
children.description: Text after the number.

settings.description: Animated statistics with a counter effect and optional prefixes or suffixes.
A single icon from the theme library — e.g. for notices or visual accents.
Icon with accompanying content — the text area can be filled freely with blocks.

fields.name: navigation
fields.label: Navigation
fields.description: Shows navigation arrows for the previous and next slide.

fields.name: pagination
fields.label: Pagination
fields.description: Shows the current slider position below the slides.

fields.name: dynamic_bullets
fields.label: Dynamic pagination
fields.description: Shows only pagination dots near the current slide.

fields.name: loop
fields.label: Loop
fields.description: After the last slide, the slider starts again from the beginning.

fields.name: autoplay
fields.label: Autoplay
fields.description: The slider starts automatically. User actions such as swiping or clicking interrupt autoplay.

fields.name: autoplay_delay
fields.label: Autoplay duration
fields.description: Time between automatic slide changes in seconds.

fields.name: has_content
fields.label: Slide content
fields.description: Enables heading, text, and buttons on all slides.

settings.description: Image or video slider with slides as child blocks.
Single slide with image or video and optional text (heading, paragraph, buttons) — only usable inside a slider.

fields.name: hero_slides
fields.label: Slides
fields.description: One slide shows a static hero. Two or more become a slider.

fields.default_value: Add structured data for your website here. This helps search engines understand your company and content and can improve how it appears in search results.
fields.content: Add structured data for your website here. This helps search engines understand your company and content and can improve how it appears in search results.

children.name: type
children.label: Type
children.description: Choose the Schema.org type that best describes the website or organization.

children.name: organization_name
children.label: Company name
children.description: The official name of the company or organization.

children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.description: A short description of the company. 120–160 characters recommended.

children.name: logo
children.label: Logo
children.description: The main company logo. Preferably an SVG or high-resolution PNG.

children.name: image
children.label: Image
children.description: A representative image of the company, e.g. office, store, or team.

children.name: phone
children.label: Phone number
children.description: The main phone number, preferably in international format (e.g. +49 821 123456).

children.name: email
children.label: Email address
children.description: The main contact email address.

children.name: website
children.label: Website
children.description: The website URL. Leave empty to use the site address automatically.

children.name: street
children.label: Street
children.description: Street name and house number.

children.name: country
children.label: Country
children.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. Germany or DE).

fields.default_value: Show site-wide notice popups for visitors. If more than one notice is enabled and matches the current page and schedule, the first entry in the list is shown.
fields.content: Show site-wide notice popups for visitors. If more than one notice is enabled and matches the current page and schedule, the first entry in the list is shown.

children.name: enabled
children.label: Enabled
children.description: If more than one notice is enabled, the first matching notice takes priority.

children.name: start
children.label: Start date and time
children.description: If empty, the notice is treated as already started.

children.name: end
children.label: End date and time
children.description: If empty, the notice has no end date.

children.name: show_again
children.label: Show again
children.description: Controls when the notice appears again after it has been shown.

children.name: show_again_after
children.label: Show again after
children.description: Number of days after showing before the notice can appear again.

children.name: extra_class
children.label: Extra CSS classes
children.description: Separate multiple classes with spaces.
